topSignals.title: Germany's Netzpaket and EEG 2027 won't get a Bundestag vote this month after all — BEE now expects the second/third reading in the week of November 9-13, with Bundesrat review targeted for November 20.
topSignals.text: Despite this monitor's repeated Oct 16 target marker, neither bill appeared on this week's Bundestag agenda; negotiators reportedly need more time after extensive criticism at the expert hearing, and the renewable-energy association BEE is separately reviewing whether the EU Commission can approve the EEG quickly enough for a January 1 start. This pushes out the dated catalyst most relevant to SOFC behind-the-meter/islanded deployment rules in Germany by roughly a month. pv magazine

topSignals.title: Bloom Energy moves up its Q3 2026 earnings date to October 22 — five days earlier than the Oct 27 date this monitor has carried since early September.
topSignals.text: Results will be released after market close with a call at 2:00pm PT/5:00pm ET. This becomes the nearest dated catalyst for Bloom, ahead of FuelCell Energy's Nov 10 lead-plaintiff deadline. Bloom Energy

topSignals.title: Priority stacks Elcogen and Topsoe remain quiet (27 and 52 days respectively since their last company news); today's one concrete AI-datacenter supply-chain signal is a $138.5M LS Electric order from Bloom Energy for high-voltage switchgear and transformers at a Pennsylvania site expected to host up to 2 GW of fuel cells — likely Aligned's "Project Phoenix" campus (unconfirmed by the companies).
topSignals.text: Elcogen's newsroom still shows the Sept 21 Metrosert cooperation announcement as its latest post; Topsoe's most recent SOFC/SOEC item remains the Aug 27 H1 2026 results. DatacenterDynamics | Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new company news. Direct check of elcogen.com/category/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest post (27 days old). Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new company news. topsoe.com/press-releases still shows the Aug 27 H1 2026 results (DKK ~4.4bn special-items charge, raised 2026 outlook) and the March 2026 SOEC pathway reset as the most recent items (52 days old).

Today's dedicated rotation (Miura, Shell, Denso, Thermax, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol), 7-day lookback: No new items for any of the six. Results were old or non-substantive: a Miura/Ceres maintenance-network item confirmed dated 2020; a Shell-Doosan-Hyundai maritime SOFC MoU confirmed dated 2024; Denso and Thermax results were entirely SEO-aggregator "2025 strategy" pieces (enkiai.com) with no primary disclosure; Fraunhofer IKTS results were a thyssenkrupp nucera/IKTS SOEC pilot-line item and older institutional pages, no new 2026 dating confirmed. Chaozhou Three-Circle (CCTC) received its third dedicated search in this monitor and again returned no company-specific SOFC/SOEC news in English or Chinese — this remains an open data gap.

Rotation sweep — Convion, Hexis, SK ecoplant, Nexceris: no 2026-dated news; only the already-logged Sept 2023 SK ecoplant/Bloom 500 MW agreement and Nexceris' existing $60M LEVER/SOEC deal resurfaced.
Rotation sweep — Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN: no English- or Chinese-language company news found again; both remain standing data gaps.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin): no new stack/cell-technology items beyond what is already logged; see Market & Financials and AI Data Center Deployments for today's Bloom items.

New:* LS Electric (South Korea) received a 185.3bn won (~$138.5M) order from Bloom Energy to supply 38kV high-voltage switchgear and distribution transformers for a Pennsylvania data center, with deliveries expected April-July 2027. The article (DatacenterDynamics, Oct 14) says Bloom is expected to deploy up to 2 GW of fuel cells at the site behind-the-meter; the companies didn't name the project, but it is likely Aligned Data Centers' "Project Phoenix" campus in Shippingport, PA (unconfirmed). This is a balance-of-plant/electrical-infrastructure supply-chain datapoint rather than a new fuel-cell order itself, but it corroborates the scale of the standing Bloom/Aligned pipeline entry. DatacenterDynamics

False positive, checked and discarded:* A "Teledata/Conrad Energy/Bloom Energy" Manchester data center hydrogen-ready SOFC story (1.2 MW) resurfaced in today's search but is confirmed, via multiple dated sources, to be a December 2021/January 2022 announcement — not new.

New (see Top Signal #1):* Germany's Netzpaket and EEG 2027 Bundestag votes are now expected in the week of November 9-13, 2026, with Bundesrat consideration around November 20 — not this week as the standing calendar had targeted. pv magazine

New:* Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) cabinet consideration, targeted for Oct 14, is now confirmed NOT to have happened on that date — the published agenda for the Oct 14 (62nd) cabinet session covers a sugary-drinks tax amendment, a climate-friendly-shipping action plan, child/youth media-protection key points, and several budget/administrative items, with no KWK-Gesetz item. This resolves the "not reconfirmed" carry-forward flag from the past several days: the cabinet consideration has slipped past its originally targeted date, with no new date yet identified. Bundesregierung

New (see Top Signal #2):* Bloom Energy (BE) will release Q3 2026 results after market close on October 22, 2026, with a call at 2:00pm PT/5:00pm ET — five days earlier than the Oct 27 date this monitor has carried since early September. Bloom Energy
